name: Candidate refuses references on first probe but recovers on second — initial_hedge, not refusal
notes: v5.6.0 fixture backfill: reference_initial_hedge — exercises the cumulative-tracker recovery downgrade path.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Backend engineer, 6 years across Swiggy and Zomato on the discovery team.

transcript.text: Why are you considering a switch?

transcript.text: Want to move into agentic-search — current scope is mature for me.

transcript.text: Rebuilt the discovery ranking pipeline — cut p95 from 800ms to 220ms over a four-month rollout.

transcript.speaker: ai
transcript.text: Can you share two professional references — ex-managers preferred?

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: Rather not share any references right now — let me think about it.

transcript.speaker: user
transcript.text: 60 days, buyout possible at one month gross with manager sign-off.

transcript.text: ₹35 LPA fixed, ₹6 LPA variable paid out at 85% historically, ₹3 LPA joining bonus.

transcript.text: Coming back to references — we'll need at least two before the offer.

transcript.text: I have two references ready — my ex-manager from Swiggy and a peer lead from Zomato. Will share their contacts.
